page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.re6.52xlarge is a memory-optimized instance belonging to the ecs.re6 server family. It is powered by dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CL processors built on the x86_64 architecture, delivering a total of 208 virtual central processing units (vCPUs). The instance features a massive memory allocation of 3072.0 GB of RAM, translating to approximately 14.77 GB of memory per core.

This instance operates on the KVM hypervisor. It does not include any local storage or bundled GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers between the instance and other cloud resources.

Given its high memory-to-vCPU ratio, the ecs.re6.52xlarge is designed for memory-intensive enterprise workloads. The qualitative cost profile reflects a high-density resource allocation where the cost is concentrated on the massive RAM capacity. This setup is highly efficient for workloads that require large datasets to reside entirely in memory, such as large-scale in-memory databases, SAP HANA deployments, heavy data caching layers, and complex enterprise resource planning systems.
